# HSLuv conversion

`hsluv.py` is the unmodified official HSLuv Python implementation, version 5.0.4.
Source: https://github.com/hsluv/hsluv-python/blob/master/hsluv.py
Retrieved 2026-09-06. The palette metadata records its SHA-256.
Copyright Alexei Boronine; see `HSLUV-LICENSE` (MIT).

Vendored so the palette generator can reproduce its HSLuv coordinates without
requiring an additional Python installation step.
